limitations: Only four nominal mu=0.7 cells; the17-mu matrix is not yet complete.
Original remote validation proofs are hash-bound to copied reports/records/training metadata; weights are not locally reverified.
N=1 descriptive cell, not a statistical backend ranking or success probability.
Reference ends6.96s; native episode ends6.98s. Full tracking is unavailable without extrapolation; overlap is separate.
No alignment, root correction, smoothing or dynamics replay is applied.
Intended nonzero beta is not a failure; only reference-relative error is reported.
Height, tilt and zero measured ground load are not tracking failure gates.
Native contact measurements and equal target mu do not imply equivalent contact laws or identical measurement operators.
rendering_limitations: Camera-only revision; original native states, reference and metrics are unchanged.
One camera distance is selected once across all frames/cases; target is each original root plus fixed offset, with fixed world orientation and FOV.
Independent translation following is requested for visual readability. Compare XY drift in the fixed-world maps, not robot position within a following viewport.
Only four nominal mu=0.7 cells; full 17-mu matrix is partial, stopped at 46/68.
Native CPU MuJoCo deployment is not GPU MJWarp validation. N=1 per cell; 50 Hz video does not resolve continuous 400 Hz contact.
No filtering, interpolation, height correction, dynamics stepping, policy inference or additional training.

notes: Official MJCF/STL assets are preserved; generated robot.xml changes only meshdir, names the floating root joint, and adds IK/display sites.
left/right_wheel sites are wheel hinge centers, not human ankle frames; left/right_knee sites are actual knee joint centers.
left/right_contact are nominal local bottom markers: they rotate with the wheel and are NOT rolling contact points or reliable ground clearance. Compute clearance from collision geometry instead.

Official MJCF and Isaac USD share link offsets and joint axes, but are not numerically identical dynamics models. MJCF base includes fixed IMU mass; wheel collision axial width is 0.010m versus 0.050m in USD, and lateral collision offsets are +/-0.008m versus +/-0.00707m.
Official MJCF wheel motor ctrlrange is +/-40Nm, while the imported USD drive maxForce is 80. Other collision primitives also differ; no cross-engine contact or actuator equivalence is implied.
Mink IK playback does not validate contact forces, balance, jump actuation, self-collision avoidance, or dynamic feasibility. No Isaac assets or runtime are changed.

validation.note: Geometric/FK checks only. Contacts include margin contacts and do not prove dynamically feasible balance or jumping.
